target.definition: The number of tokens per minute processed by Alphabet's first-party models (e.g. Gemini) via direct API use by customers, as first stated with Alphabet's Q3 2026 results.

inputs.name: q2_2026_tokens_per_minute
inputs.description: API tokens per minute stated by Alphabet for Gemini models at Q2 2026 earnings

provenance.quote: Gemini models now process 22 billion API tokens per minute

inputs.name: quarterly_growth_factor
inputs.description: Multiplicative growth in stated API tokens per minute from one quarterly earnings disclosure to the next

provenance.rationale: Recent Gemini API token-per-minute disclosures have grown roughly 30-50% per quarter; wide interval reflects uncertainty in deceleration or acceleration

inputs.name: quarters_elapsed
inputs.description: Number of quarterly reporting periods between the Q2 2026 statement and the Q3 2026 statement

provenance.rationale: Q2 2026 to Q3 2026 is exactly one quarterly reporting interval

inputs.name: q2_2026_quarterly_revenue
inputs.description: Alphabet total revenue in Q2 2026, used as a scale anchor

provenance.rationale: Alphabet quarterly revenue has been running near USD 100 billion in 2026

inputs.name: q3_2026_quarterly_revenue
inputs.description: Alphabet total revenue in Q3 2026, used as a scale anchor

provenance.rationale: Q3 typically slightly above Q2; modest sequential growth assumed

inputs.name: tokens_per_minute_per_revenue_dollar
inputs.description: API tokens per minute processed per dollar of quarterly Alphabet revenue, calibrated from the Q2 2026 disclosure

provenance.rationale: 22 billion tokens/min divided by roughly USD 100 billion quarterly revenue gives about 0.22 tokens/min per revenue dollar

inputs.name: revenue_growth_factor
inputs.description: Multiplicative growth in Alphabet quarterly revenue from Q2 2026 to Q3 2026

provenance.rationale: Sequential quarterly revenue growth of a few percent

inputs.name: token_intensity_growth_factor
inputs.description: Growth in API token intensity per dollar of revenue from Q2 2026 to Q3 2026

provenance.rationale: AI API usage growing faster than overall revenue, but with wide uncertainty

inputs.name: global_ai_api_tokens_per_minute
inputs.description: Total tokens per minute processed across all major AI API providers globally in late 2026

provenance.rationale: Order-of-magnitude estimate of aggregate frontier-model API throughput across providers

inputs.name: alphabet_api_share
inputs.description: Alphabet/Gemini share of global AI API token throughput

provenance.rationale: Gemini is a major but not dominant API provider; share of global token volume uncertain

paths.description: Grow the Q2 2026 disclosed tokens-per-minute by one quarter of growth
Scale Q2 2026 tokens-per-minute by revenue growth and token-intensity growth
Estimate global AI API token throughput and take Alphabet's share
